4. `realpath "$(git -C /work/repo-b/.worktrees/feature-shared-change rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)"`

- No closing gate-history line and no standing-grant line, because the restore did not succeed.

The session stays idle. Repair repo-b's worktree, or the sibling declaration, then re-run `/skill:gauntlet-resume`.
